title: Let introspections record several causes, open hypotheses,
summary: Introspection records hold one `cause` and nothing for doubt. I read OLY-R1-03 as adding three optional lists to the introspection answer and record: other contributing causes, unresolved hypotheses and contradictory evidence. The mechanism is then recorded in docs/spec.toml with a measure ending `status: not shown` and a test.

defaults_applied.how: New tests for the lists, and cargo fmt, clippy and test must pass.
The criteria check the record contents through tests rather than the existence of fields.
The requirement is enforced in code, in apply_answer and the record, and recorded in docs/spec.toml.
One focused change to the introspection record and answer.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Goal and audience: Athena's maintainers and the hestia review, who need introspections that show doubt instead of one confident cause.

Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs (Answer at ~873, answer_schema at ~1028, apply_answer at ~1468 which redacts and plain-words each text field and sets record.cause) and crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs (IntrospectionRecord with deny_unknown_fields, and validate). The entry point is the introspect run that calls apply_answer. The model's answer is checked in apply_answer before the record is filled. The record fixture and round-trip test are in crates/athena-data/src/records.rs (~1706) and must stay valid. That file holds the allow-list for `athena.introspection/1`. The new fields are serde(default, skip_serializing_if empty), so old records still parse and check_record_file and the AnyRecord round trip still pass. The property is measured directly on the record's new fields, not through a stand-in.

Design: add `other_causes`, `open_hypotheses` and `contradictions` (Vec<String>) to the record and to Answer (serde default), to the answer schema and to the prompt text. apply_answer redacts and plain-words each entry, caps their count, and drops empty entries. `cause` stays the main cause, so cause counting in hestia is unchanged.
Existing code: extends crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs, crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs and docs/spec.toml; creates no new module.
Term ladder: not used in this request.

The measure keeps `status: not shown`, because `athena status` prints no line for these lists. It names the test command, so the label 'mistakes' stays out of it. Adding a status line is out of scope.

No refusal rule is added or tightened. The only new refusal is a reworded or unredactable entry, which fails the introspection the same way the existing fields do. Expected 0% of newly refused readings.
Consumers: none found. No config deliverable is planned.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-R1-03 has a mechanism naming introspect.rs and the new record fields instead of "none". It keeps owner Athena. Its measure names the test command and ends with `status: not shown`.

crates/athena-data/src/records/introspection.rs IntrospectionRecord has optional, serde-default fields for other causes, open hypotheses and contradictions. Grep for the field names also finds them in Answer and answer_schema in crates/athena-core/src/introspect.rs, and the prompt text tells the model to list them.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`. A new test feeds an answer with two extra causes, one open hypothesis and one contradiction. It asserts that the recorded IntrospectionRecord holds all of them and that validate() passes. Without the mechanism the test does not compile or fails.
Run `cargo test -p athena-data`. An old-format introspection record without the new fields still parses, and the existing records round-trip test passes.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core introspect`. A new test shows that an answer with an unredactable entry or a word the admission scan rejects in a new list is handled like the existing fields: the introspection is recorded as failed, with a reason.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test`. All three pass.

out_of_scope: Adding an `athena status` line for these lists.
departures: Slightly higher cost and lower pass rate than the reference. The change spans two crates and a deny_unknown_fields record, so a round-trip or fixture failure is plausible.
